summary.text: John Lastinger is a Republican state representative from Lexington County who has represented South Carolina House District 88 since December 2025 and is seeking election to a full term on November 3, 2026.
A pastor, Lastinger has led EDGE Church since 1978 and serves on the House Medical, Military, Public and Municipal Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: Lastinger earned an associate degree from Midlands Technical College in 1974 and another from Gloryland Bible Institute in 1978.

He has been pastor of EDGE Church since 1978, founded Covenant Christian Academy & Childcare in 1984 (now EDGE Christian Academy), and owned and operated WQXL Christian Radio during the 1980s and 1990s.
Lastinger was elected on December 23, 2025, to fill the unexpired term of R. J. May III, who resigned.
In the November 3 general election he faces Democrat Jeremy Jones.
